evals.name: positive-trigger-site
evals.prompt: Extract the design system from https://linear.app and make a DESIGN.md I can drop into my repo.
evals.expected_output: The skill fires in site mode, gathers tokens from CSS variables and computed styles (no invented hex values), writes DESIGN.md with YAML token front matter and sections in spec order (Overview through Do's and Don'ts, then Responsive Behavior, Iteration Guide, Known Gaps), runs npx -p @google/design.md designmd lint until no errors, and reports path, token counts and known gaps.

evals.name: positive-trigger-brief
evals.prompt: ทำ DESIGN.md for a calm, accessible healthcare scheduling app, light theme.
evals.expected_output: The skill fires in brief mode; the Overview opens with 'Invented from a brief:'; tokens include primary plus on-* pairs; lint passes contrast checks.

evals.name: negative-trigger
evals.prompt: Here's our DESIGN.md — build me a pricing page that follows it.
evals.expected_output: Does not fire: building UI from an existing DESIGN.md is in the Not-for clause; route to design-md-apply instead.
